Hi Karthik,

We're going to be in SF the week of Oct 12 for a customer site visit and a short field event. Our window on the 12th is pretty tight — we only have a 45-minute slot between meetings (roughly 2:00–2:45pm PT). Would Redwood be able to do a condensed walkthrough of the platform in that window? If not, would you be able to record a short live demo we can watch later?

Attendees from our side would likely be: me (Samir, Head of Ops) and Natalie (Product). We may have one engineer join for the Q&A if schedules allow. The priorities for the session are:
- a quick look at hosting options (hosted vs dedicated)
- latency/cost controls and any known throughput guarantees
- short Q&A about private deployment and audit logs

If a compressed live session is possible, we can keep it to 30–35 minutes and push detailed follow-ups to a separate call. Let me know what works and who from Redwood would lead. Also — if you send a short agenda we can route it to our onsite organizer.

Thanks,

- 5 min: quick intros and scope confirmation
